narr: The combination of abundant low-level moisture along with MLCAPE of greater than 1000 J/KG led to the development of terrain-induced thunderstorm activity across portions of Joshua Tree National Park during the early to mid-afternoon hours.
ev: Big Horn Pass road was closed due to flooding and debris on the roads. No damages or injuries were reported. Timing based from radar.
lsr: ***DELAYED REPORT*** BIG HORN PASS ROAD COMPLEX CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING AND DEBRIS ON THE ROADS.
